reason.description: Why the job stopped. upload_incomplete: a file of the capture is not in storage. photo_too_small: a photo is below the minimum the render needs. needs_wider_view: a photo room where not even a refresh around the existing seating fits in what the photo shows; a photo from the opposite corner may help. timed_out: a stage ran past its limit and its retry. internal: an error on our side; trying again may work.

retryable.description: True when asking again (the same room or design request) may succeed; false when the capture itself must change.

awaiting_brief.description: True when the room is read and no design request has been made yet: designing starts as soon as the app sends one.
awaiting_brief.title: Awaiting Brief

confidence_level.description: The room twin's confidence level, once the room is read. estimated: sizes say measure to confirm and no item carries a fit claim.

design_request_id.description: The latest design request for the room, once one is made.

items.description: Every item of every design, once designs exist; empty before.
items.title: Items

schema_version.description: Contract version of the object. Minor versions only add optional fields.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

stages.description: The pipeline rows behind `stage`, room rows first, then the latest design request's.

post.description:
Store a capture whose files are already uploaded, make its room and start the
pipeline. Safe to repeat.
Log a buy or rent tap and return the retailer link for it. Safe to repeat.

get.description: Liveness check. Does not touch the database or any model provider.

delete.description:
Erase the caller's account and everything stored for it. There is no undo.

The request is recorded and the erasure starts at once; it finishes within
minutes. Safe to repeat: a repeat starts the erasure again where it stopped.

get.description: The caller's own identity. Guests have one too.
The caller's rooms, newest first, each with its status.

post.description:
The room for a registered capture. Registering the capture already made it and
started it; this returns it, and starts it again if it failed. Safe to repeat.

get.description:
One room's status: its stage, why it failed, how it was measured, and per design
item whether a fit check ran.
The room's latest design request: its job status and, once ready, the three Designs.

post.description:
Ask for designs for a room with a brief, at any point: before the room is read,
designing starts as soon as it is. Safe to repeat with the same id.

get.description: The room's SpaceTwin: its measurements, what is in it and its hero views.

post.description: Plan a new upload and get signed URLs for its parts.
Join the uploaded parts into the stored file.
After a dropped connection: which parts arrived, and fresh URLs for the rest.
